en.headline: Court of Final Appeal refuses Gregory Wong leave to appeal LegCo riot conviction
en.dek: The Appeal Committee found the actor had not raised reasonably arguable grounds to challenge his conviction and six-year-two-month sentence for the 2019 storming.
body: The Court of Final Appeal’s Appeal Committee has refused actor Gregory Wong Chung-yiu leave to appeal against his conviction and six-year-two-month jail term for rioting over the storming of the Legislative Council chamber on 1 July 2019.

Wong was convicted after trial and later lost an appeal to the Court of Appeal in March this year. He then applied for leave under case FAMC 28/2026. Last Friday the Appeal Committee, comprising permanent judges Roberto Ribeiro and Johnson Lam and non-permanent judge Patrick Chan, issued a written order refusing leave after finding he had failed to put forward reasonably arguable grounds.

The original prosecution involved 14 defendants. Eight pleaded guilty to rioting. Wong and three others were convicted after trial. The 12 people convicted of rioting received terms ranging from just over 54 months to 82 months. Two others were acquitted of rioting but convicted of entering the chamber precinct and fined.

zh.headline: 終審法院拒絕黃秋生就立法會暴動案提出上訴許可
zh.dek: 上訴委員會裁定演員未能提出合理可爭辯理由，挑戰其因2019年衝擊立法會被定罪及判囚六年兩個月。
body: 終審法院上訴委員會拒絕演員黃秋生就2019年7月1日衝擊立法會會議廳的暴動罪定罪及判囚六年兩個月提出上訴許可。
黃秋生經審訊後被定罪，今年3月上訴至上訴法庭亦被駁回。他其後根據案件FAMC 28/2026申請上訴許可。上周五，由常任法官李義、林文瀚及非常任法官陳兆愛組成的上訴委員會發出書面命令，指他未能提出合理可爭辯的理由，拒絕批出許可。
原案檢控涉及14名被告，其中八人承認暴動。黃秋生與另外三人經審訊後被定罪。12名被裁定暴動罪成者判刑由超過54個月至82個月不等。另兩人被裁定暴動罪不成立，但進入會議廳範圍罪成並被罰款。
